title: Restitution as a remedial interest
summary: Restitutionary relief can restore benefits the claimant conferred on the other party.
notes: The focus is on the benefit transferred, such as a payment, rather than every expenditure incurred in preparing to receive performance. The Mobil Oil note uses restitution after breach despite questions about whether the venture would have been profitable. A damages calculation should distinguish a transfer to the defendant from an expense paid to someone else. Restitution can also be an independent basis of liability for unjust enrichment, introduced at pp. 145–146.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 18–21. Open assigned page 18.
